name: refuse-sweep-through-itself
why: A sweep whose last leg runs back across its first built as one 'valid' solid with the overlap counted twice: nothing in the graph looks beyond one bend, and BRepCheck_Analyzer does not look for faces crossing. spine_contact flags the path coming back within twice the section's reach, and BOPAlgo_CheckerSI on the swept solid confirms and locates it.

message_contains: sweeps a section along its path
apart, or use a smaller section
